scripts.build: npm run build:css && npm run build:js
scripts.build:js: esbuild resources/js/admin.js --bundle --minify --format=iife --target=es2020 --legal-comments=none --metafile=dist/admin.meta.json --outfile=dist/admin.js && node scripts/licenses.mjs && rm dist/admin.meta.json
scripts.check: npm run build && git diff --exit-code --stat -- dist/ || (echo 'dist/ is out of date: run npm run build in packages/admin and commit dist/admin.css and dist/admin.js.' && exit 1)
